title.zh: 将巴拉望省Marcos市镇的名称正式变更为Jose P. Rizal博士市镇的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Marcos, Province of Palawan, to Municipality of Dr. Jose P. Rizal
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Municipality of Marcos, Province of Palawan, to Municipality of Dr. Jose P. Rizal
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Thị trấn Marcos, Tỉnh Palawan thành Thị trấn Dr. Jose P. Rizal
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อเทศบาล Marcos, จังหวัด Palawan เป็นเทศบาล Dr. Jose P. Rizal
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Kotamadya Marcos, Provinsi Palawan menjadi Kotamadya Dr. Jose P. Rizal
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Perbandaran Marcos, Wilayah Palawan menjadi Perbandaran Dr. Jose P. Rizal

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6652_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Municipality of Marcos in the Province of Palawan is hereby changed to Municipality of Dr. Jose P. Rizal.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
